entries.def: (= pleased and excited about going home soon)
entries.example: I'm looking forward to going home.

entries.def: (= pleased and excited when it is going to happen)
entries.example: I always look forward to my birthday.

entries.word: I look forward to hearing from you
entries.def: [This is a common way to end a formal letter.]

entries.example: A: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
Which would you prefer?

entries.def: 'I'd rather' is the same as 'I'd prefer to', but is more common in spoken English.
entries.example: I'd rather go to the cinema.
A: Are you interested in Latin American music?
No, it doesn't interest me (at all).
